F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.BCa: bias-corrected accelerated bootstrap over seeds, 5000 draws, alpha 0.05, key via fold_in(K_analysis, tag='bca_T_d_comparison')
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.IQR_overlap_def: IQR = [Q25,Q75] per condition; overlap = length(intersection)/min(length(IQR0),length(IQR8)); >0.80 indicates distributions coincide
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.decision: If FALSIFIED, u-recovery pacemaker hypothesis rejected on d-necessity leg; if not falsified (T shifts outside CI or IQR disjoint), hypothesis survives this leg
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.direction: Falsifies pacemaker claim that d matters: if T unchanged when d zeroed, d not causal for period
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.formal: Let T_{a=0.02,d=0} and T_{a=0.02,d=8} be per-seed T distributions (n=5 seeds, same seeds paired) in W=[1500,2000). FALSIFIED if ALL: (i) median(T_d0) in BCa 95% CI of median(T_d8) (5000 draws, K_analysis key), (ii) IQR overlap >80% (overlap length / min(IQR_Td0,IQR_Td8) >0.80), (iii) mean_rate_E >5 Hz in both conditions (not silent) on same seeds. Metric T = median peak-to-peak of r_E.
F1_d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged.verbatim: d_zero_leaves_T_unchanged: FALSIFIED if median T(d=0) within BCa 95% CI of T(d=8) on same seeds W=[1500,2000) AND IQR overlap >80% AND rate>5Hz (not silent); metric T = median peak-to-peak of r_E

F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.decision: If FALSIFIED, u-recovery pacemaker hypothesis rejected on tau-tracking leg; requires monotonic T(tau) with significant rho and correct slope
F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.formal: Across a_E scan at fixed d=8 (a in {0.01,0.02,0.04} => tau_u in {100,50,25} ms), with T per seed per a level (n=15 total: 5 seeds x3 tau), compute Spearman rho(T,tau_u) and linear slope of T vs tau_u (or T vs log tau). FALSIFIED if EITHER: (i) rho <0.40 with p >=0.05 (no monotonic tracking), OR (ii) slope not within 30% of predicted ln-ratio slope. Predicted slope: for recovery pacemaker, T ~ k*tau_u or T ~ k*ln(tau_u / tau0) per Izh single-cell scaling; predicted slope = (T_baseline / tau_baseline) * tau scale or derived ln-ratio: slope_pred = DeltaT_pred / Deltatau = T_{a=0.02} * ln(4)/ln( (1/0.01)/(1/0.04) )? Operationally: slope_pred = linear regression slope of log-spaced tau predictor vs observed T_baseline scaling; tolerance +-30% (0.70*slope_pred <= slope_obs <=1.30*slope_pred). If rho >=0.40 with p<0.05 AND slope within 30%, hypothesis survives this leg; else FALSIFIED.
F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.predicted_slope_note: Predicted ln-ratio slope derived from single-E Izh scaling: T scales with tau_u (or ln tau), so going 25->100 ms (4x tau) predicts T ratio ~ ln(4)/ln(2) ~2 or linear ~4 depending on regime; prereg locks to linear tau scaling as default (slope_pred = T_{0.02}/50) and allows log-slope variant as sensitivity check reported separately — primary gate is linear within 30%
F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.slope_tolerance: within 30% of predicted ln-ratio slope (i.e., observed slope in [0.70*pred, 1.30*pred])
F2_a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u.verbatim: a_scan_does_not_track_tau_u: FALSIFIED if Spearman rho(T,tau_u) <0.40 with p>=0.05 OR slope of T vs tau_u not within 30% of predicted ln-ratio slope

falsifiers_per_R3_patch.joint_verdict: Hypothesis REJECTED if either falsifier fires (FALSIFIED); hypothesis SUPPORTED only if neither falsifier fires AND adequacy guards pass; otherwise UNRESOLVED_silent or INVALID

hypothesis.alternative: T tracks tau_u=1/a_E and depends on d_E after-spike jump
hypothesis.name: u_recovery_pacemaker
hypothesis.not_a_repair: This battery does not alter, re-score, or re-interpret frozen E2 V1 NEGATIVE_NOT_PING_LIKE verdict; V1/V2 remain sealed negatives. e2_c is a new prospective experiment branching from theta*.
hypothesis.null_like: T is independent of a_E/d_E (delay/topology or noise pacemaker)
hypothesis.scope: Tested at frozen theta* only; no claim about other operating points; bounded interpretation per E2_SYNTHESIS
hypothesis.statement: Population pulse period T at theta* is set by the E-cell recovery variable u (a_E/d_E), not by E-I loop delay or network topology. Under Izhikevich dynamics dv/dt=0.04v^2+5v+140-u+I, du/dt=a(bv-u), spike reset v<-65,u+=d, tau_u=1/a sets recovery timescale.

izhi_E_recovery.d_E_definition: post-spike increment of u (adaptation step); d_E in {0, 8.0}; 8.0 is native E value, 0 tests necessity of spike-triggered jump vs pure tau
izhi_E_recovery.tau_u_definition: tau_u = 1 / a_E (ms) in reduced units; a_E in {0.01,0.02,0.04} => tau_u in {100,50,25} ms

metric.W_primary_note: W=[1500,2000) is the frozen E2 V1 adequacy window; kept identical for comparability; no tuning
metric.computation: r_E = mean spikes per ms across 800 E neurons smoothed with same filtering as E2 pulse characterization only for peak detection; median peak-to-peak interval across detected pulses within W; returns T_ms per seed per condition
metric.definition: median peak-to-peak interval of r_E (excitatory population rate) in analysis window W=[1500,2000) ms; r_E binned at dt_ms 0.5 native (fs 2000 Hz); peak picking via parabolic interpolation consistent with e2_ping_prereg method
metric.name: T
metric.rate_guard: mean_rate_E >5 Hz required for T interpretation (not silent); if rate <=5 Hz, condition is UNRESOLVED_silent, not used for falsifier comparison

FALSIFIED_vs_NEGATIVE.NEGATIVE: adequate but no falsifier fired and effect size absent yet not meeting falsifier contrarian threshold (e.g., rho 0.2 n.s.) => NEGATIVE (no evidence for pacemaker, but not falsified by strict contrarian)
FALSIFIED_vs_NEGATIVE.frozen_ordering_note: INVALID; !G_adequate -> UNRESOLVED; FALSIFIED per R3 falsifiers; NEGATIVE vs FALSIFIED per frozen ordering (E2 V1 NEGATIVE_NOT_PING_LIKE ordering preserved; this battery independent)
